template.name: Renko Live Charts Pimped
template.entry_long: close > ema(close,{p0}) + atr(high,low,close,{p1}) and close > open
template.exit_long: close < ema(close,{p2}) - atr(high,low,close,24) and close < open
template.notes: Renko bars do not exist in this engine, so a brick step measured as one documented AtrPeriod=24 unit away from the base line stands in for the direction flip. BoxSize=10m and UseAtrMa/AtrMaPeriod=120 have no expressible price equivalent, and the docs state no stops.
